ody.text: Laquatus, made Ambassador for his ability to change forms, helped the Cephalids replace the merfolk eggs, so that through his treachery the merfolk lost most of their empire.
On land he chased the Mirari, using the psychically grafted Turg and hypnotizing Kirtar and Cabal members with false memories.

He ended up with the Mirari when Kirtar crystallized the Order's fortress, then stoked Aboshan's fears, and with Fulla stopped the emperor at the cost of Turg's life before taking the Mirari to Cabal City.
His quest failed in the end: Llawan imprisoned him in the Otaria Chasm and destroyed his army, until Llawan had the rebels massacred and Balthor was sent to hunt him.

tor.text: In Torment, Laquatus plots to seize the Mer Empire while Chainer rises in the Cabal, and Chainer creates Burke for him.
Laquatus starts a civil war in the Mer Empire and schemes with both the Order and the Cabal.
His army is defeated in the Aboshan Trench, and Llawan's mages trap him in a bubble, where he swears revenge.

jud.text: Trapped by Llawan's mages and failing diplomatically with the Order and the Cabal, Laquatus goes to the mainland with Burke to retrieve the Mirari, and plays an Order contingent against a Cabal battalion.
Eesha, Braids and Llawan's envoys reveal his plotting and abandon the quest, leaving him without support.
Laquatus mind-controls the zombified Balthor into fighting Kamahl, who strikes down his old mentor at Balthor's plea and then kills Laquatus with the Mirari sword.
